Subject: Workshop availability grid + staffing & travel windows for Lumina Therapeutics exec session

Hi Kate / Liam —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call last week. We discussed an in-person executive workshop to validate the integration plan and run a short ops rehearsal. To keep momentum, can you confirm which of the following multi-day windows works best for your core team (exec + platform leads):

- Tue/Wed July 12–13 (preferred by our product leads)
- Tue/Wed June 28–29 (alternate)
- Mon/Tue Aug 2–3 (backup)

High-level asks from your side so we can lock logistics: headcount per day (approx), any attendee travel constraints, AV needs (NDI/HDMI/recording), and a preferred arrival window (same-day vs. overnight).

We're planning a two-day on-site agenda with a hybrid dial-in for extended reviewers. Internal plan: Grace will lead the agenda and customer success facilitation, Monica will run the technical integration breakout, and Tessa will own travel & room ops. I'll coordinate exec alignment and escalation responses.

If you confirm a preferred window by EOD Wednesday (May 26), we'll send calendar holds + a draft runbook and staffing roster for your review.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marcus Lin

Hi Marcus —

Thanks — quick answers below: we are leaning strongly toward July 12–13. That aligns with our exec calendar and gives the SRE team time to prep.

Headcount:
- Day 1 (alignment + roadmap): 10 internal (including CEO + VP Eng) + 6 external observers (partners)
- Day 2 (technical deep-dive): 8 technical (platform + SRE) + 4 exec observers

Arrival: most prefer to arrive the evening before (July 11) to avoid same-day travel. A couple of remote-only folks will dial in for the afternoon of Day 1.

AV: standard HDMI + room recording good; we will want a local projector and an RTMP recording if possible. Also can you record a separate session feed for the SRE breakout?

Dietary: two attendees are vegetarian, one has a nut allergy.

Pre-read: we'll circulate a brief compliance checklist and a list of systems we want to sandbox. Can you send a 1-pager runbook/agenda and a staffing grid so we can match internal roles?

Kate

Lumina Therapeutics
